lines.en: As expected. Lord Godfrey was never going to let this happen peacefully.
lines.zh: 正如预料的那样。戈弗雷勋爵从未打算和平解决此事。

lines.en:
I must reach the capital, here. Be on guard, we can surely expect even more resistance than what we see now.  Pray we do not face his elite Arbalest units again, they have proven quite deadly.
Florina, I dread the idea of bringing a child to this battlefield. But you must know that these men are coming for you.  You must stay near me, but stay safe. Just until we make it to Armitage in one piece.
I will stay near! I trust you, Captain Antares!
lines.zh: 我会的！我相信你，安塔瑞斯队长。

lines.en: Thank you. Donar watch over us.

How absurd! This is the great hope for all Veridia? This small child?!  What has she done to earn Donar's favor? What could she do?!  Captain Antares, a true lapdog, to the very end. Arbalests, destroy him!
lines.zh: 太荒谬了！这就是全维尔迪亚的希望？一个小娃娃？！ 她做过什么可以得到多纳尔青睐的事？她又能做什么呢？！ 安塔瑞斯队长直到最后也不过是条走狗。钢弩部队，击溃他吧！
